decision: We will require a personal LIVE line's single core ON noctus-net with no published host ports (shadow lines keep the core off noctus-net).
options_considered: (a) drop the network check for no-edge lines; (b) invert it: live core must be on noctus-net (the product must reach it) and must not publish host ports, inside the policy hash [CHOSEN, approved by tech-lead eb1bed9e]; (c) keep an edge in front of a send-enabled line (contradicts _validate_policy). Privacy of a live line rests on the shape checks (no presence/history) + the allow-list in agents and the assistant send seam.
